module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Cumulative Remainder Lot Drift Over 1,000 Consecutive Trades
precondition: 1,000 trades executed with 0.01 remainder each under Round-Robin policy.
steps: 1. Measure cumulative volume across all 3 sub-accounts.
expected_result: Total volume delta across all accounts is <= 0.01 lots; zero cumulative bias.
actual_result: Cumulative remainder drift over 1,000 simulated trades is strictly bounded to 0.01 lots.
